activities: Confirm research team; ethics review; conflict disclosures; file structure; source and variable naming.
output: Approved protocol, role matrix, risk register.
decision_gate: Do not recruit or collect sensitive data until consent and storage procedures pass review.

activities: Verify core sources; acquire PTA/PBS/economic tables; build 2014-2016 pilot candidate pool.
output: Source registry v2 and candidate-pool pilot.
decision_gate: Proceed only if every candidate has a release date, public source, and deduplication status.

activities: Code 30 pilot tracks from 2014, 2020, and 2025; test mutable metric capture and version rules.
output: Pilot dataset, missingness report, schema revisions.
decision_gate: Revise fields that exceed 25 percent avoidable missingness or produce systematic coder confusion.

activities: Conduct 4-5 pilot interviews; test consent, income bands, role-specific probes; begin balanced recruitment.
output: Interview memo, revised guide, recruitment matrix.
decision_gate: Pause if anonymity cannot be credible for small professional cells.

activities: Complete candidate pools and sample for 2014-2019; double-enter 10 percent of metadata.
output: First 180 track records and QC log.
decision_gate: Check annual strata and rolling three-year diversity before freezing selections.

activities: Complete candidate pools and sample for 2020-2025; capture platform metrics in one dated batch.
decision_gate: Freeze capture date and document unavailable or deleted content before analysis.

activities: Audit source provenance, duplicate works, metric comparability, interview-cell coverage, and ethics incidents.
decision_gate: Do not begin modelling until critical provenance and denominator failures are corrected.

activities: Complete most artist, producer, intermediary, rights, and live-sector interviews; assemble 80-100 artist histories.
output: De-identified transcripts, artist dataset draft, reflexive memos.
decision_gate: Recruit negative and inactive cases if successful artists dominate the sample.

activities: Double-code 120 tracks/videos; complete six case-study evidence matrices and right-of-reply requests.
output: Content dataset, reliability report, case memos.
decision_gate: Downgrade or revise codes that fail reliability thresholds.

activities: Run descriptive, concentration, network, career, and exploratory models; complete qualitative cross-case matrices.
output: Reproducible analysis notebook/scripts and findings table.
decision_gate: Separate findings from propositions and label all unresolved data gaps.

activities: Triangulate claims, test negative cases, conduct sensitivity checks, verify quotations, and solicit expert challenge.
decision_gate: Remove or weaken claims that lack traceable evidence or survive only one convenient specification.

activities: Draft report; complete harm and copyright review; archive reproducible materials; publish de-identified outputs.
output: Final report, public data package, methods appendix, limitations register.
decision_gate: Publish only after source, privacy, accessibility, and reproducibility checks pass.
